blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Lexical analysis identifies tokens, while syntax analysis checks grammar and generates a parse structure.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Semantic analysis checks rules beyond grammar such as type compatibility or declared identifiers; optimisations can transform intermediate code.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: A linker combines object files and resolves symbols/libraries; a loader places the executable into memory for execution.
